Name: Building Stats
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center]Building Stats is a mod that allows you to make many changes to buildings that can be built on your Farm!

------

[b]Each building has its own set of configs, that allow you to adjust the following stats:[/b]
- Builder
- Build number of days
- Build cost
- Build required materials
- Magical Construction toggle
- Hay Capacity
-Indoor Map swap (buildings with interiors only)

[b]Additionally, animal houses (Coops, Barns, their upgrades, and Slime Hutches) can also adjust the following stats:[/b]
- Max occupancy
- Type of Farm Animals allowed (Coop, Barn, Slime, All)
- Option to include a Heater as a default Machine
- Option to include an Auto-Grabber as a default Machine
- Option to include an Auto-Petter as a default Machine
- Option to allow/disallow for default Machines to be moveable

------

The Greenhouse is also (by default) made available to purchase after you complete the Pantry at the Community Center.

Farmhouses can be made buildable, and by default are an upgrade to the Cabin.

------

[b]Additionally, every building has an optional "Unlock" requirement that can be set to whatever you would like from one of the following options:[/b]
- Lowest level reached in Mines
- Player ability level
- Player money earned
- Random availability
- Seasonal availability
- Year requirement

Each of these unlock requirements can have a value applied to them, to designate exactly when you like those buildings to become available.

------

[b]Few things you can do with this mod:[/b]
- Make Cabins have a Big Shed interior
- Allow Coop and Barn animals to share homes
- Make Cabins into Greenhouses.
- Make all buildings instant build
- Make all buildings much easier or harder to get
- Have Robin build Obelisks or the Wizard build Coops

------

This mod uses ItemIDs for setting the Material cost of buildings.

To find ItemIDs of items, I recommend using a resource such as: [url=https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids/]Stardew IDs[/url]﻿﻿

(Big thanks to [url=https://github.com/MateusAquino/stardewids]MateusAquino[/url]﻿ for making this extremely useful website)

Use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make editing the buildings even easier.
